chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When a man leaves his home for travel, he is not permitted to divorce [his wife] until three months have passed.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a husband to divorce his wife while he is traveling?
ai.summary: In the context of *al-Ishtibār*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a protective measure for wives during their husband's absence, preventing impulsive divorce while the husband is away. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on marital stability and the husband's responsibility to maintain household cohesion even during travel, ensuring the wife is not left in a state of uncertainty for an extended period.
